t: What Wide-Column Model Internals Is All About
title: What Wide-Column Model Internals Is All About
description: How wide-column stores work: partition keys, clustering order, LSM storage, tunable quorums.. This database covers Wide-Column Model Internals with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Storage engines trade write amplification, read amplification, and space amplification; pick two.

Compaction is LSM's background tax; tune its shape.
